description: How to build your Context OS — education module for AIOS reports

module.title: Building Your Context OS
module.outcome: AI that knows your business identity, rules, and preferences

sections.title: Why Context OS Matters
sections.content: Without context, AI gives generic answers. With a rich Context OS, AI produces work that's indistinguishable from your own output. The Context OS is what transforms AI from a generic assistant into YOUR assistant.

before_after.without_context: Dear Client, I wanted to follow up on our recent discussion...
before_after.with_context: Beste Henk, naar aanleiding van ons gesprek over de jaarrekening 2025 wil ik graag de volgende stappen bespreken...

before_after.without_context: Generic proposal template with placeholder text
before_after.with_context: Branded proposal using your pricing structure, referencing the client's specific situation from your last 3 meetings

sections.title: Creating Your CLAUDE.md
sections.content: CLAUDE.md is the master file that tells AI who you are, how you work, and what rules to follow. Place it in the root of your Claude Code project.
steps: Start with Business Identity: who you are, what you do, your specialization
Add Communication Rules: tone, language, compliance requirements
Add Decision Frameworks: approval thresholds, escalation rules
Add Process Standards: SOPs, quality checks, deadlines
Add Service Catalog: what you offer, pricing structure
Review and refine — let a colleague read it and spot gaps
tips: Write it like you're training a new employee on day one
Be specific — 'professional tone' is vague, 'formal Dutch, always use u-form' is clear
Include anti-patterns — what should AI NEVER do
Update it monthly as your business evolves

sections.title: Setting Up Memory Files
sections.content: Memory files give AI persistent context about clients, projects, and operations. Organized in directories by topic.

memory/clients/.purpose: Per-client context that persists across sessions
contents: Engagement: Annual audit + tax advisory since 2023
Preferences: Prefers email over phone. Meetings Tue/Thu only
Open items: Q4 VAT filing (due March 15), audit planning (April)
Notes: Price-sensitive, compare fees annually. Values speed over detail
Status: Planning phase, kick-off scheduled Jan 20
Decision: Using new materiality threshold per 2025 standards
Blockers: Waiting for bank confirmations from ING
Key change: enhanced risk assessment for going concern
Regulator focus areas: sustainability reporting, IT controls

sections.title: Maintaining Your Context OS
sections.content: A Context OS only works if it's kept current. Build maintenance into your routine.

maintenance_tasks.task: Update client files after significant meetings
